newsitem.title: FRANCE: UAP still assessing Channel Tunnel damage.
newsitem.headline: UAP still assessing Channel Tunnel damage.

text.p: Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP) said on Friday its experts were still assessing damage from the Channel Tunnel fire and did not know when it would be able to make an announcement about the impact on its accounts.
"The experts are over there checking the loss and damage," said a spokeswoman. "We do not have any figures yet."
A source close to Eurotunnel has estimated the cost of the damage at tens of millions of pounds.

Assurances Generales de France (AGF) said on Thursday that Monday's fire would have little impact on the insurer which is re-insured and whose exposure is limited to 10.5 percent of property damage and operating loss.
AGF is co-insurer for the Channel Tunnel and its operator, Eurotunnel, along with primary insurer UAP. They are exposed to infrastructure damage and operating losses.

A spokeswoman for re-insurer Scor said on Thursday that the cost of the fire to the group was expected to run to between five and 10 million francs. But the company said it did not expect the fire to have an impact on this year's results.
U.S. group Chubb Corp insures rolling stock in the sub-sea tunnel.
